Error Handling (DefaultError Handler)

  • JsonProcessingException (bad JSON, wrong type, missing field)  → no retry → straight to DLT
  • Other exceptions (e.g. transient DB failure) → retry up to 3 times (FixedBackOff 0ms) → DLT if still failing

auto-created by Kafka broker
offset IS committed (no replay)

processClick(click)
1. isTooLate? yes → LateEventSink
    no → continue
2. clickStore.addClick()
3. watermark.update(eventTime)
4. emitSafePageViews()

processPageView(pageView)
1. isTooLate? yes → LateEventSink
    no → continue
2. add pv to per-partition buffer
3. watermark.update(eventTime - allowedLateness)
    ← conservative shift
4. emitSafePageViews()

emitSafePageViews(partition, watermark)
for each pv in buffer:
  safeEmitTime = pv.eventTime + allowedLateness
  if watermark >= safeEmitTime:
    clickStore.findAttributableClick(userId, eventTime)
    build AttributedPageView
    outputSink.write() ← durable before ack
    remove from buffer

WatermarkTracker
Map<partition, Instant>

updateWatermark() — monotonic
isTooLate() — eventTime < watermark - lateness
getMinWatermark() — min across partitions

ClickStateStore

(sorted by event_time)

addClick() — per-user ReentrantLock
findAttributableClick() — subSet [pv-30m, pv]
evictOldClicks(cutoff)

<partition, List<PageViewEvent>>
